assets.label: Technomancien
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite revision for Project RL, a grimdark futuristic/cyberpunk roguelike on 64px world cells. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: retain its identity, material colors, clothing/armor layout, proportions and pose. Input images 2 and 3 are ONLY the already accepted finish references (Bastion and Cerbere), never characters to copy. Render the target as a complete detailed source master with the same matte worn game painting, broad readable shadow planes, believable folds and material volumes, controlled irregular dark contours, restrained highlights and locally placed wear. No glossy plastic, sterile vector/cel shading, thick uniform outlines or excessive noisy microdetail. Readable after reduction to about 60 game pixels tall. Same slightly elevated frontal standing sprite view as the targets; not isometric and not directly looking down on the head. Neutral diffuse overhead lighting. Whole figure from top of head to soles, all limbs complete, generous clear margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No ground, floor, scene, cast shadow, frame, words, labels, glow or effects. Standing with feet a little apart and EMPTY gloved fists held slightly out to the sides at waist level, bent elbows, ready for separate weapon attachments. No weapon or new accessory. The technomancer class: sealed graphite helmet and respirator, graphite technical suit, muted blue chest armor and blue shoulder panels, small restrained orange utility details, dark gloves and practical boots. Keep the human proportions, closed face, existing armor layout and short jacket silhouette.
